title: Edit Video by Typing: How AI Does the Cutting

sections.heading: Everyday Analogy
sections.body:
Think of editing video like cooking from a recipe. Old way: you chop every vegetable by hand on a timeline.

New way: you type 'make it shorter and remove silences' and a kitchen robot does the chopping. You still choose the taste, the robot does the cuts.

sections.heading: Why It Exists
sections.body:
These tools exist to save time and skill. Text-to-video generation means AI creates video from typed words. AI avatar cloning means AI copies your face and voice to speak new lines.

Transcript-based editing means you edit video by editing its written words. Automated silence removal and storyboarding means AI finds quiet parts and builds a rough story for you. Chat-style editing commands means you tell AI what to change in plain chat.

sections.heading: What Can Go Wrong
sections.body:
What can go wrong? Avatars can look fake or misuse your likeness. Auto-cuts can remove important pauses or jokes.

Transcript errors can delete the wrong clip. If you rely only on typing, you lose fine control over timing and style.

steps.narration: You type what you want in plain words instead of dragging clips.
AI turns your words into editing instructions.
AI reads the transcript and finds silences to know where to cut.
AI makes the cuts or creates a new avatar clip from text.
You check the result because auto-edits can make mistakes.

quiz.q: What does transcript-based editing let you do?
options: Edit video by editing its written words
quiz.why: The save shows you edit the transcript text and the video updates to match.

quiz.q: What fails first if usage grows 100x and everyone uses avatar cloning?
options: Likeness misuse and fake-looking avatars get worse
quiz.why: At scale, avatar cloning risks fake results and misuse of face/voice, plus auto-cuts can remove important parts.

quiz.q: Why do chat-style editing commands exist?
options: To replace manual timeline chopping with typing
To remove the need to review
quiz.why: They exist to save time and skill by letting you type 'remove silences' instead of cutting by hand.

extra: Modern tools often combine speech-to-text, large language models, and generative video models to enable these typing workflows.
